name: amfx-eurusd-equity-ratio
description: amFX reproduction (17JUN22 p2): EURUSD vs Europe/USA equity ratio. Original uses SX7P (Euro Stoxx Banks) / ES (S&P 500 futures). Proxy: EUFN (iShares MSCI Europe Financials) / SPY. European equities outperforming US = capital flows supporting EUR. Co-movement Feb-Jun 2022, divergence favoring EUR is the buy signal. Third leg of Donnelly's EUR buy thesis alongside BTP-Bund spread and rate differentials.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: EURUSD vs EU/US EQUITY RATIO (17JUN22 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Brent Donnelly's third pillar of EUR buy thesis:
# - European equities outperforming US equities → EUR supportive
# - Original: SX7P (Euro Stoxx Banks) / ESc1 (S&P 500 futures)
# - Proxy: EUFN (iShares MSCI Europe Financials ETF) / SPY
# - Co-movement visible Feb-Jun 2022; recent divergence favors EUR
# - Admitted as "useless real-time indicator" but adds weight of evidence
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
eurusd = src.c
idx = index()

# European financials ETF (proxy for SX7P Euro Stoxx Banks)
eufn = reference_stocks(ticker='EUFN')()
eufn_close = eufn.c

# S&P 500 ETF (proxy for ES futures)
spy = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.SPY)()
spy_close = spy.c

# EU/US equity ratio: EUFN / SPY
# Multiplied by 100 for readability
eq_ratio = eufn_close / spy_close * 100

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: EURUSD and Equity Ratio Overlay
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='Is European Equity Outperformance Signaling EUR Strength?',
    category='EUR Equity Flows',
    y_axis_label='EU/US Equity Ratio (EUFN/SPY x100)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EU/US Equity Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EURUSD', color=Color.Gray)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(eq_ratio, eurusd))
